function: Excluded (function): the learned network detects a UAV and predicts its 3D trajectory from uplink CSI, which is target positioning and tracking; it learns no beams, waveforms or resources. p. 9: "a sequence of Lo position estimates"; p. 13: "Overall positioning error has a median of approximately 4.5 m".
notes: Reason: function (Step 1, rule 5), positioning or localization is an excluded function. p. 1 abstract: the scheme "passively detects uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) by exploiting channel anomalies" in the first Fresnel zone, using a two-stage DL framework (appearance-time detector, then a BiLSTM with attention for trajectory prediction; pp. 7-9). The network outputs the 3D UAV coordinates (p. 9) and is scored by positioning RMSE against a particle filter (pp. 12-13). It does not design beams, waveforms or resources for sensing and communication (area 5); the communication link is not changed by the learned model. Channel estimation is least squares, not learned (p. 5: "The BS recovers the channel via least squares estimation"). Angle estimation is classical spatially smoothed 2D-MUSIC with a closed-form CRLB (pp. 10-11) and "does not require DL training" (p. 15). Learning is present, so no_learning does not apply; the learning acts on CSI of the physical layer to track a non-cooperative target, not on UAV control, so above_phy does not apply. Setup for the reviewer: single-antenna UEs, 10x10 URA base station, no RIS, 2.6 GHz, own geometry-based Rician simulator (pp. 2, 5, 11). A reviewer may confirm that passive sensing on the communication uplink is not area 5.
